name: accessmcp
description: Microsoft Access tools for AI agents: inspect schemas, read and write data, edit VBA, run health reports. Free account included — read tools are free, write tools come with the trial and Pro.

access_file_path.title: Access database
access_file_path.description: Full path of the .accdb, .mdb or .adp file this plugin's MCP server works on. One database per plugin install; for more databases use the Access-MCP extension or add one MCP server entry per database.
